instructions.zh: 在 Steam 库中右键点击幻兽帕鲁，选择「管理」→「浏览本地文件」。
instructions.en: Right-click Palworld in your Steam library and choose Manage → Browse local files.

instructions.zh: 打开 Pal\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss 目录，选中 UE4SS.log，拖入日志上传区域。
instructions.en: Open the Pal\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss folder, select UE4SS.log and drag it into the log upload area.

instructions.zh: 在日志所在文件夹中选中 UE4SS-settings.ini，拖入日志上传区域。（只有作者要求时才需要上传）
instructions.en: Select UE4SS-settings.ini in the same folder as the log and drag it into the log upload area. (Only upload if the author requests it)
